This is observable historical evidence, not a psychological diagnosis or skill score. Realized outcomes use actual SELL execution prices; paper outcomes use the Market Data Contract's same-day close. This is not a full Odean replication and does not reproduce tax-lot, commission-adjusted, or daily high/low research data treatment.
